# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work for one person or station; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens in parallel belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a number of seconds), `variable` (a range with min, max, and default), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** anchors a step to the clock or chains it to another step — `programStart` at t=0, `programStartOffset` at a delay, `afterStep` when another step ends, `afterStepWithBuffer` with a pause after another step, `manual` when the user taps, or `compound` to wait for multiple triggers. `stepId`s must be unique across the entire program, not just within a track. Every `task` that a step uses needs a matching `resourceConstraints` entry; that entry's `maxConcurrent` number prevents two steps from using the same piece of equipment (one bench, one erg, one barbell) at the same time. Work repeated n times (n rounds of a superset, n sets of an exercise, n instances of anything) is declared with `replicates: {count: n, mode: ...}` on a single step — never as n copies of the step or n separate tracks. Subsequent work that applies per instance uses `instances: "each"`, work that waits for all instances uses `instances: "all"`, and when a constraint like a recovery area can only hold k instances at once, `maxInFlight: k` holds back the upstream step instead of leaving downstream work starved.

For this 2-person partner workout, I expect these resource constraints:

| Task | maxConcurrent | Reason |
|------|---|---|
| bench | 1 | One flat bench with barbell; partners take turns |
| dumbbells | 1 | One pair of dumbbells; partners take turns |
| pull_up_bar | 1 | One pull-up bar; partners take turns |
| erg | 2 | Two rowing ergs; both partners can row simultaneously during warm-up and cool-down |

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "bench", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "dumbbells", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "pull_up_bar", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "erg", "maxConcurrent": 2 }
  ],
  "actors": 2
}
```
